name: fylgja
title: Fylgja
description: Jump to the places you work in, ranked by your local Fylgja daemon.
author: TODO-raycast-handle

commands.name: navigate
commands.title: Fylgja Navigator
commands.description: Jump to a window or session, ranked by Fylgja.

preferences.name: defaultRanker
preferences.title: Default Ranker
preferences.description: Name of the ranker to start with. Empty uses the daemon's default.

preferences.name: days
preferences.title: Days
preferences.description: How many days back the while-away list looks.

preferences.name: onlyOpen
preferences.title: Open Items
preferences.label: Only items with something open
preferences.description: Hide items that have no open window or session.

preferences.name: groupByDay
preferences.title: Grouping
preferences.label: Group by day
preferences.description: Group the items by the day of their last focus.

commands.name: journal
commands.title: Fylgja Journal
commands.description: Show the journal of the focused checkout, with actions on its items.

commands.name: journal-menubar
commands.title: Fylgja Journal in Menu Bar
commands.description: Show the first sentence of where you are in the focused checkout, in the menu bar.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Daemon Address
preferences.description: Address of the local Fylgja daemon.

preferences.name: secretFile
preferences.title: API Secret File
preferences.description: File that holds the Fylgja API secret.

scripts.lint:local: eslint src test && prettier --check src test package.json tsconfig.json README.md
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:local && npm test
